Test elements list: after addElement, elements() contains added, after removeChild, removed.

Test submit: need to set action attribute and method attribute; ensure that method GET/POST chosen correctly, and that formData is passed as data. Since Jsoup.connect returns a Connection, we can't easily inspect internal data without executing; but we can use a custom Connection? Actually Jsoup.connect returns HttpConnection which stores data. So we can verify.

Also test when action attribute missing: uses baseUri as action. Provide baseUri, ensure not empty.

Also test that submit throws IllegalArgumentException when action cannot be determined (empty baseUri and no action). Provide empty baseUri string? Need to trigger Validate.notEmpty. Provide baseUri null? The constructor requires baseUri string; pass "" maybe. No action attribute, baseUri empty -> should throw.

Implement tests.
